hooks.name: Run Tests Before Commit
hooks.description: Runs the Lune test suite (property tests and unit tests) before any commit is made, ensuring regressions are caught before code is pushed.

action.prompt: If the current shell command is a git commit, first run `lune run tests/run_tests.luau` and verify all tests pass. If any tests fail, do NOT proceed with the commit — fix the failing tests first. If tests pass, proceed with the commit.
